topic: Data monitoring and deployment process improvements
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered multiple technical topics, including data analysis for inventory segments, dwell time research, and the development of new real-time/hourly recalculation processes. A key discussion point was improving monitoring capabilities, specifically regarding box status (RMS) and ensuring alerts trigger if a physical box is online but no data is received.

Regarding infrastructure, there were discussions about updating the CH system to version 23.1.2.9 on the sandbox environment. The team also discussed automating deployment processes, with suggestions for automatic staging deployments immediately after building, which was countered by advice against full automation and a preference for manual control (a 'pedal'). It was agreed that if automated deployment is pursued, it should be manageable via parameters or dropdown lists within tools like Rundeck.
decisions: The CH system update to version 23.1.2.9 will be performed on the sandbox environment.
Automated staging deployments are possible but require careful implementation (e.g., using parameters/dropdowns in Rundeck) and should not fully replace manual deployment controls.
action_items: Someone needs to ensure monitoring alerts are set up for physical boxes that report 'online' status but lack data feed.
The team needs to discuss the best method for implementing controlled, automated deployments (e.g., via Rundeck).
